cover_prompt: Full-color illustration, warm serene nature aesthetic, premium coloring book cover artwork. A peaceful sunlit forest path winding through tall ancient trees, dappled golden light filtering through the canopy. Wildflowers and ferns line both sides of the trail. A gentle stream flows alongside the path with smooth mossy rocks. In the distance, a misty mountain peak rises above the tree line. Soft warm color palette with greens, golds, and earth tones. Butterflies and small songbirds add life to the scene. The composition feels immersive and inviting, drawing the viewer into the walk. Premium quality, rich detail, calming meditative atmosphere. Text on cover reads: Mindful Nature Walks Coloring Book for Adults.
